mission.title: Mission & Vision
mission.text: A safe, adapted environment where every child matters.
mission.headline: Mission & Vision
detailParagraphs: Rază de Soare Special School is committed to offering every child with special educational needs a safe, stable environment adapted to their individual needs, where personal development, autonomy and communication are fundamental priorities.

Our work serves children and young people with moderate, severe and profound intellectual disabilities who need structured educational interventions, ongoing support and a setting where progress is measured in real steps toward independence and social inclusion.
detailList: developing practical life skills and personal autonomy;
encouraging functional communication and emotional expression;
building social skills needed for community inclusion;
supporting families through educational partnership and constant care.
detailParagraphsAfter: Small classes of 6–8 students, coordinated by two teachers, allow a personalized approach and support tailored to each child. The focus is on individual progress, each child’s own pace, and celebrating every achievement.
At the heart of our educational work is respect for every person’s dignity and the belief that every child deserves real opportunities to grow.
The vision of Rază de Soare Special School is an educational community where difference is not a limit, but a starting point for support, understanding and growth.

We want a society in which children and young people with intellectual disabilities are seen through the lens of their potential, not their limitations. A society where inclusion means real participation, and community integration is supported through adapted education and responsible interventions.
Within the RCE “Speranța Copiilor” foundation, our school promotes values such as respect for life and human dignity, responsibility toward others, compassion and mutual support.
We believe true education is not about making everyone the same, but about careful accompaniment and ongoing support. Every child is unique, and learning must respond to that uniqueness.
Through our work, we aim to help young people become as autonomous as possible — able to communicate, take part in community life and develop the skills needed for a more independent life.

education.title: Education
education.text: Every child learns in their own way.
education.headline: Education – Every child learns in their own way
detailParagraphs: At Rază de Soare Special School, education is a responsibility we approach with seriousness, professionalism and care for every child. We believe every student deserves access to quality education adapted to their needs and abilities.

Learning follows the school curriculum, methodologies and standards of special education. Subjects and learning activities are adapted to each student’s age, developmental level and special educational needs.

With the support of qualified, dedicated staff, we pursue clear educational goals using adapted teaching methods, patience and individualized attention. Every child is encouraged to learn, develop skills and progress at their own pace.

For some students, progress means learning to read, write or count. For others, it may mean recognizing a letter, communicating more easily or gaining essential everyday skills. We respect each child’s potential and value every achievement, knowing that behind every step forward there is work, perseverance and trust.

development.title: Development
development.headline: Development – Every step forward matters
detailParagraphs: Every child has their own pace of learning and development. At Rază de Soare Special School, we want every child with special educational needs (SEN) to receive the support and encouragement they need to build skills and become, step by step, more independent.

For some children, progress means learning to read, write or recognize letters and numbers. For others, it may mean holding a pencil correctly, using cutlery, dressing themselves, communicating more easily or expressing their needs.

We place special emphasis on personal autonomy and independent living skills. We help children understand and follow a daily routine, recognize unsafe situations, relate to others and learn practical things that support everyday life.

We know that the development of children with special educational needs requires patience, practice and plenty of encouragement. That is why we adapt learning activities to each child’s needs and abilities — without rush and without comparisons.

For us, every achievement matters. A letter learned, a word spoken, an object used correctly or an activity done for the first time without help are important steps toward greater confidence and independence.

activities.title: Activities
activities.headline: Activities – Every experience matters
detailParagraphs: At Rază de Soare Special School, we believe every child deserves the joy of discovering, trying and succeeding — at their own pace.
Through drawing, painting, music, creative workshops and practical activities, children develop dexterity, patience and confidence in their own abilities.
Outdoor outings, games and extracurricular activities give them the chance to explore the world, communicate, make friends and enjoy beautiful moments together.
For some children, holding a brush correctly, finishing a drawing or singing with classmates may seem small. For us, each of these achievements means a great deal.
Because sometimes behind a simple gesture there is a lot of work, patience and courage. And every step forward deserves to be celebrated.

Volunteering at the school is an opportunity to gain practical experience, build knowledge and better understand the specifics of educating children with special educational needs.
If you would like to volunteer at our school, you can contact us by phone or email for more information.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: The controller of this website is Rază de Soare Special School, based in Arad, Diogene Street no. 12, email: razadesoarerce@yahoo.com, phone: 0257 214 805.
This policy explains how we process personal data in connection with use of the site, under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable Romanian law (including Law no. 190/2018).

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: On the public area of the site we do not collect personal data through our own online forms. If you contact us by email, phone or social media, we process the data you send us (for example name, email address, phone number and message content) in order to reply.

Your browser may store technical preferences locally, without identifying you as a person: RO/EN language and the floating menu position on the preview site. The accessibility tool does not store settings on your device; every page load starts from the native look.

The read-selected-text feature (text-to-speech), when enabled, runs locally through the browser / operating system. Selected text is not sent to the school’s servers; voice quality depends on your device.
The site administration area is for authorised staff only. Sign-in uses Firebase Authentication, which stores session data needed for the account to work.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: We process data to: communicate with people interested in the school; keep the site running and secure; provide accessibility features you turn on; and meet legal obligations where they apply.

Legal bases may include: legitimate interest (running an informational website and user-requested accessibility tools), steps at the request of the person (replying to contact), and, where required, a legal obligation or consent.

sections.heading: 4. Recipients and third-party services
paragraphs: The site is hosted on cloud infrastructure (Vercel). Google Fonts may be used to display fonts. Those services may process IP address and technical connection data under their own policies.

Links to external sites (for example the 3.5% tax redirection form on formular230.ro or the school’s Facebook page) lead to independent controllers. We do not control how they process data after you leave our site.
We do not sell personal data and we do not use it for behavioural advertising on this site.

sections.heading: 5. Retention
paragraphs: Contact messages are kept as long as needed to handle the request and afterwards for any legally required archiving or to defend legal rights.

Preferences saved in the browser (language, menu position) remain until you delete them in your device settings or until a site update replaces them. Accessibility-tool adjustments are not persisted and return to the native defaults on page reload; you can also reset them anytime from the tool panel.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and, where applicable, portability, as well as the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, under the GDPR.
You may lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP).
To exercise your rights, email razadesoarerce@yahoo.com or contact the school by phone.

sections.heading: 7. Children and students
paragraphs: The site is informational for parents and the interested public. We do not intentionally request personal data from minors through the public area. Published images and materials respect, as far as possible, the legal framework on image rights and pupil protection.

sections.heading: 8. Updates
paragraphs: We may update this policy when how the site works or the applicable law changes. The current version is the one shown on this page.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By accessing and using the Rază de Soare Special School website you accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: 5. External links
paragraphs: The site may contain links to external resources (for example formular230.ro, Google Maps, Facebook). Those sites have their own terms and policies. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

sections.heading: 6. Availability and accuracy
paragraphs: We make reasonable efforts to keep information accurate and up to date, but we do not guarantee the absence of errors or uninterrupted operation. Admission, calendar or procedure details can be confirmed at the school or via the contact details shown.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, the school is not liable for indirect damages resulting from use of or inability to use the site, including technical interruptions or actions of third parties.

sections.heading: 8. Governing law

Questions: razadesoarerce@yahoo.com · 0257 214 805 · Arad, Diogene Street no. 12.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files stored by the browser on your device. Similar technologies (for example localStorage) may save technical preferences needed for the site to work.

sections.heading: 2. What we use on this site
paragraphs: At present, on the public area of the site we do not set analytics, advertising or behavioural tracking cookies.

We use local browser storage (localStorage) for: language preference (Romanian / English); the floating menu position on the preview site. This data stays on your device and is not sent to us as a marketing profile.

The accessibility tool (text size, contrast, brightness, read-selected-text) does not store preferences on your device: every page load starts with the native / default site look. Adjustments stay active only for the current browsing session on that page (until reload).

Optionally, during a browsing session the browser may temporarily keep (sessionStorage) a technical flag related to showing mobile navigation hints. It does not identify you and disappears when the session ends.
Read-selected-text (text-to-speech), when enabled, uses the browser / system speech API. We do not upload the selected content to our servers for analytics or advertising.
For sign-in to the administration area (authorised staff only), Firebase Authentication session mechanisms may be used, as needed for account security.

sections.heading: 3. Third-party services
paragraphs: When loading fonts (Google Fonts), the browser may contact Google servers, which may process technical connection data under Google’s policy.
When you follow external links (Facebook, formular230.ro, Google Maps), those sites may set their own cookies, outside our control.
Speech synthesis for reading text may use components provided by the operating system or browser; those may have their own device-level policies, which we do not control.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis and necessity
paragraphs: The technical storage above is used to provide the features you request (showing the site in the chosen language and keeping the interface preference). Under ePrivacy rules, such strictly necessary means may be used without a separate consent banner.
If we later add statistics or marketing tools that require consent, we will update this section and ask for your agreement before enabling them.

sections.heading: 5. How you can control browser data
paragraphs: You can delete cookies and site data in your browser settings (history / privacy / site data). After deletion, language and menu position may return to defaults.
In the accessibility tool you can tap “Reset settings” to immediately restore text size, contrast, brightness and text reading to the native site look, without deleting other browser data.
Most browsers allow blocking third-party cookies; this usually does not affect the main content of our site in the current setup.

sections.heading: 6. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about cookies and local storage: razadesoarerce@yahoo.com · 0257 214 805.

admitere.title: Admission
admitere.text: Requirements and steps for admission to Rază de Soare Special School.
admitere.heading: Admission criteria
paragraphs: Rază de Soare Special School serves children and young people diagnosed with moderate, severe or profound intellectual disability.
Admission requires a disability grading certificate and a school orientation certificate toward special education.
The admission process includes an interview with parents or legal guardians and an assessment of the child, to determine compatibility with the school’s profile and to identify educational needs.

structura.title: School year structure
structura.text: School year calendar, course modules and holiday periods.
structura.intro: The school year at Rază de Soare Special School follows a modular system, with periods of classes alternating with inter-module holidays. This structure allows regular breaks for students and staff, supporting a sustainable pace of learning and recovery.
structura.heading: Modular organization
paragraphs: The school year is divided into five course modules, separated by inter-module holidays. Each module is a focused period of educational activity, followed by a break that helps students recover and families align with the school rhythm.

The modular structure is adapted to the needs of children with special educational needs, reducing fatigue and keeping a balance between demands and rest. The calendar is shared with families in advance and aligned with Ministry of Education rules.

about.historyTitle: History of Rază de Soare Special School
about.historyText: Rază de Soare Special School is one of the projects of the Christian Foundation RCE “Speranța Copiilor” in Arad, which began its work in 1992. The school was founded in January 2002 as an educational and recovery center, first for the 8 children with disabilities from the “Casa Darius” residential and recovery center within the foundation.

banners.b1: Teacher and students at an activity on the orange table
banners.b3: Two teachers and students at a classroom table

vision.title: Expanding the vision
vision.text: While RCE’s vision initially focused on helping abandoned children from orphanages and placement centers, community demand led the services to expand also to children with severe disabilities from families.

accreditation.title: Accreditation and authorization
accreditation.text: From 2002 to 2009, the Rază de Soare Educational Center operated with accreditation from the Ministry of Labor. In 2009, Rază de Soare Special School was authorized by the Ministry of Education for preschool and primary education and is now accredited for preschool, primary and lower-secondary cycles.

education.title: Adapted education and personalized attention
education.text: Over the years, “Rază de Soare” has grown steadily, offering adapted education for enrolled preschoolers and students. Our program covers kindergarten (small group) through 10th grade, with small classes (6–8 students) coordinated by two teachers per class, to ensure personalized attention and real progress for every student.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Over time, our mission has grown beyond teaching alone, becoming a holistic support center that promotes inclusion, personal development and the dignity of every child.
